page_note: 本页为IEA《Energy Technology Perspectives 2024》第48页，主体是图1.12（上下两个未命名面板的分组柱状图，含100%“Local demand”参考线）加注释与一段正文。

heading.title: Production of selected clean energy technologies and materials relative to
heading.subtitle: domestic demand by country/region, 2023

components.evidence: three bars (red, blue, green) side by side in every category slot such as 'Wind nacelles'
a green horizontal rule drawn at 100% across both panels, legend entry 'Local demand'
single legend 'China / European Union / United States / Local demand' below both panels
legend row sits under the lower panel's category axis, outside the plot
upper axis tops at 200%, lower axis tops at 150%
two stacked panels of the same grouped-bar chart, technologies above, materials below
'Notes: Battery cells are for both electric vehicles and stationary storage. Steel includes crude steel...'

new_components.name: boxed_category_axis_cells
new_components.evidence: category names sit in a bordered row of cells with vertical dividers between 'Battery cells' and 'Electric cars'
new_components.why_it_matters: 类目轴被画成表格式方格，取值时须按方格边界而非刻度线分组，容易把相邻类目的柱子归错列。

new_components.name: unnamed_panels_distinguished_by_categories
new_components.evidence: two panels carry no titles; only the category sets (technologies vs Alumina…Fertilisers) tell them apart
new_components.why_it_matters: 无面板名意味着表格行只能用类目+系列定位，读者必须靠类目集合推断所属面板与其0–200%/0–150%量程。

new_components.name: takeaway_caption_below_figure
new_components.evidence: bold blue line under notes: 'China is a net exporter of key clean energy technologies, while the European Union...'
new_components.why_it_matters: 结论句在图下方且加粗，读数时的语义上下文（谁净出口/净进口）不在标题内，需另行抓取。

new_components.name: license_credit_line_below_plot
new_components.evidence: right-aligned 'IEA. CC BY 4.0.' between the legend and the notes line
new_components.why_it_matters: 该行既非来源也非数据链接，解析时易被误当作Source行而污染表格上下文。

difficulty_notes: 图上一个数字都没印，全部要靠像素对刻度。上面板刻度间隔50个百分点约占63像素，即1像素≈0.8个百分点：读185时5%容差有±9.3点余量，问题不大；但读12时5%容差只有±0.6点，不到1像素，实际不可能落在容差内；同理55与Aluminium的美国柱（约53）差约4%，已在容差边缘。再加上China 'Steel'（约108）与China 'Fertilisers'（约108）、EU 'Heat pumps'（约66.7）与US 'Battery cells'（约68）几乎等高，同一读数可以对应两个不同标记，取值本身而非标签成为最大瓶颈。

suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行中的面板设置：允许两面板量程不同（0–200% / 0–150%）且不写面板标题，记录字段增加 panel_key 由类目集合推断
suggestions.new_ablation_row: “面板无标题+各面板独立量程”对比“面板有标题+共用量程”，看 panel_key 缺失时行定位错误率

suggestions.what_to_add: P1 精度分级：把每个标记的可达精度按柱高与刻度像素密度打分
suggestions.where_to_change: 评分侧 readable 门限，改为按 value/tick-spacing 计算每柱容差（如12%柱容差0.6点<1像素判为不可读）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: “小值柱（<20%）计入评分”对比“仅评>20%的柱”，量化低幅值标记对总分的拖累

suggestions.what_to_add: reference_line 作为独立图例项（'Local demand' 以线形色块与柱形色块并列）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式字段：图例中混入线形样例的参考线系列，位置为 legend_below_plot
suggestions.new_ablation_row: “参考线带图例项”对比“无图例参考线”，检验解析是否把参考线误建成第4个柱系列

suggestions.where_to_change: 整页导出模板：标题块在表上、结论句与授权行在表下的相对位置
suggestions.new_ablation_row: “图下加粗结论句参与上下文匹配”对比“仅用标题匹配”，看上下文命中率变化
